title: On monochromatic path covers conjecture of Erdős--Gyárfás
summary: Erdős and Gyárfás conjectured in 1995 that, in every red--blue edge-coloring of a complete graph $K_n$, the vertex set can be covered by at most $\sqrt n$ monochromatic paths, all of the same color. Pokrovskiy, Versteegen and Williams (JCT-B, 2026) proved the conjecture for all sufficiently large $n$. In this paper, by using minimal counterexample method, we confirm the conjecture completely.
